description:
Cast Electrodominance, choosing X=3, but paying {R}{R} due to Rowan.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Rowan
Resolve Reiterate, copying Electrodominance and returning Reiterate to your hand.
